title: Fixed-deadline reaction-time inference from causal EEG
disposition_reason: The source implements meaningful causal-window, reference and target-last scoring components, but no authenticated native acquisition/event join, complete target producer or runtime exists. Cropping released acausally cleaned512Hz epochs cannot satisfy the revised causal input contract.

scientific_target.question: Among trials still at risk at a fixed100ms deadline, does EEG available by that deadline improve observed first-response-time prediction beyond contrast and instruction?
scientific_target.known_answer: Finite observed first-response reaction time in seconds after the stimulus, for every admitted at-risk trial; later missing or censored responses have no silently imputed answer.
scientific_target.answer_origin: A separately sealed behavioral/EEG clock join and complete first-response target roster are required; their authentic producer is absent.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held-person episode with matched EEG+contrast/instruction and contrast/instruction-only output vectors over identical trial IDs.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 26 original participants; sessions, original blocks and repeated trials are nested and remain grouped.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Prospective fixed-deadline inference is the intended estimand; current code only specifies downstream causal dependence. EEG predictive gain is not evidence of a causal neural mechanism.
exclusions: Released retrospective cleaned epochs are not causal observations merely because they are cropped.
No capped3s, survival, or retrospectively selected complete-case endpoint is silently substituted for total observed first-response RT.
No full source acquisition/runtime or scientific model performance has been established.

inputs: Original authenticated native1024Hz32-channel EEG with instantaneous common-average reference and forward one-pole smoother alpha1/8, started at acquisition start.
Fixed307 samples at offsets-204 through+102; three fixed channel-bin means give96reference features. Contrast and speed/accuracy instruction are allowed.
forbidden_inputs: Response-locked windows, response timing/side/correctness markers, post-deadline samples, query-fitted transformations and outcome-dependent artifact rejection.
Released512Hz cleaned epochs, zero-phase filtering, retrospective ICA, interpolation or unsupported resampling as substitutes for causal raw input.
observation_contract.case_identity: Partition/source schema requires original person/session/block/trial joins and prediction schema requires exact opaque per-arm query IDs. Original raw-to-anonymized permutation and clock joins remain missing.
observation_contract.split: All26 held-person folds; each outer training pool contains25people with complete person/session/block groups. Inner validation holds out each of those25people. Both arms use identical at-risk cases.
observation_contract.coverage: Planned52person-by-arm output sets over all admitted trials; authentic count and complete finite response roster remain unresolved. Early responses by100ms are counted privately and excluded by the declared at-risk rule, never by variable window length.

primary.name: participant-macro mean absolute error in observed first-response seconds
primary.aggregation: Mean absolute error over all admitted trials/person, then equal mean over26people; report paired contrast_instruction MAE minus EEG MAE.
primary.rationale: Measures a real behavioral target with common time units and matched observation support. Positive EEG gain is not required.

secondary: All26 paired person gains and arm losses; admitted/early-response/missing-response counts by person.
Reference fitting validity and sensitivity to allowed acquisition timing uncertainty before any scientific interpretation.

comparators.name: contrast_instruction_ridge
comparators.inputs: Contrast fraction, instruction and their interaction; no EEG, source order or response-side covariates.
comparators.procedure: Existing equal-person ridge with alphas0.1,1,10 chosen using all25 inner-person folds; training-only means/scales.

comparators.name: matched_EEG_ridge
comparators.inputs: The same covariates plus96fixed causal EEG-bin features.
comparators.procedure: Same reference-selection/fitting rule and support; fixed predictions projected only to values strictly greater than0.1seconds.

comparators.name: constant_training_RT
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed training-only constant predictor as a sanity comparator; no held-target fitting.

nuisance_controls: Use a fixed deadline and equal sample support, never response-locked or response-length windows.
Authenticate original blocks and clock join; ordinal partitioning cannot manufacture original block identity.
Handle early responses privately with predeclared at-risk eligibility; require a justified nonresponse/censoring estimand before complete target construction.
Keep side/correctness and original chronology out of primary comparator and EEG inputs.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain26 paired person gains and complete nested support. Overlapping LOPO training prevents a naive trial-level CI or simple independent-person claim; any inferential resampling requires a predeclared full fitting policy.
evaluation.failure_policy: Admit complete matching52output sets before opening sealed targets. Invalid/missing target RT is an operator fault with no score; never fill with3s. Constant predictions are valid. Missing/duplicate/nonfinite candidate outputs fail complete coverage.

implementation.scorer_target: Observed finite first-response RT with participant-macro MAE and paired neural gain, conditional on a future valid target producer.
implementation.delivered_scope: Five downstream scientific components and generated arithmetic regression checks exist; no native reader admission, target producer, isolation or launch chain is delivered.
missing: Authenticated raw roster/permissions, original identity permutation and behavioral-to-EEG clock join.
Complete at-risk response targets and scientifically justified nonresponse/censoring policy.
Physical fold/arm isolation, native filtering qualification and measured reference/resource execution.
implementation.execution_evidence: Seven generated scoring checks are described by the source README; they do not open authentic EEG or establish causal source availability. This review ran no scientific computation.

direct_observation.representation: A future fixed-window32-channel numeric or visual observation with contrast/instruction could be answered without tools.
direct_observation.boundary: Any view must use only authenticated causal samples through100ms and omit response metadata; no target-informed cropping.
missing: Native causal producer and direct response protocol absent.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential causal EEG-window renderer with identical channel/time support.
typed_viewer.boundary: Typed actions must not reveal future signal, raw acquisition paths or behavioral metadata.
missing: No typed viewer or authenticated causal input route.

tool_assisted.representation: The numerical reference modules can analyze admitted training features, but no participant per-case investigator transport is supplied.
tool_assisted.boundary: Future investigator must share exact inputs/compute and avoid held labels/cross-fold state.
missing: No investigator executor, native data producer or isolation.

frozen_program.representation: Train-only ridge components specify a possible frozen programme; no complete executable episode exists.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze full procedure before query; admit raw input and targets independently; reset folds/arms.
missing: No runtime launcher, complete source preparation or protected target producer.

evidence.supports: Existing512Hz cleaned epochs have future-influenced preprocessing; causal input chain and nonresponse targets remain unresolved.
Incomplete prospective component,26people52person-arm outputs and no native producer/runtime.
Native1024Hz forward filter, fixed[-204,+102]sample window and100ms deadline; no future source samples.
Complete26-person target-last scoring, matched-arm MAE, finite means and no3s target imputation.
Train-only equal-person ridge references,96EEG features, contrast/instruction covariates and nested person validation.

evidence.locator: data/preprocessing.py and original analysis notebooks; verified source audit reused
evidence.supports: Original cleaned-epoch writer/metadata and retrospective source preprocessing lineage.

evidence.locator: Primary contrast-decision EEG article; verified prior source interpretation reused
evidence.supports: Original task context and acquisition; new causal programme is not an original-paper reproduction.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: This revision inspected source and existing construction evidence only. The four historical neural programme attempts concern NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077, not this task; no direct-observation or typed-viewer model result is asserted here.
excluded_claims: Released retrospective cleaned epochs are not causal observations merely because they are cropped.
No capped3s, survival, or retrospectively selected complete-case endpoint is silently substituted for total observed first-response RT.
No full source acquisition/runtime or scientific model performance has been established.

summary: Make the causal100ms at-risk estimand explicit and reject released acausal512Hz derivatives as causal inputs.
Distinguish real target-last MAE components from absent raw/event/target producer and runtime.
Retain missing-response/censoring uncertainty without imputing3s or quietly changing the outcome.
revision.source_review: Inspected original registered definition, implementation source and source-bound scientific corrections. Primary-source citations reuse verified source provenance; publisher web checks were unavailable and do not add new source validation.
